name: Dreamtune
description: Access Dreamtune model requests, tool runs, GPU compute, prompts and request logs. Requires Node.js 22.20.0 or later, a scoped workspace API key and prepaid credit for paid operations.

DREAMTUNE_API_KEY.description: Dreamtune workspace API key with the scopes required for the operations you enable.

DREAMTUNE_API_ORIGIN.description: Dreamtune API origin. Set to https://api.dreamtunelabs.com for the hosted service.

DREAMTUNE_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS.description: Request timeout in milliseconds. Set to 120000 for the documented hosted setup.
